==Gender==
There is one issue that needs to be addressed.  Is the Creator a He, a SHE or an It? He and it were used interchangeably in this article. Modern church parlance is to replace any use of "His" or "He" with "God" to avoid the issue (I personally find the practice distasteful, but I also admit to some old-fashioned notions), so it may be appropriate to do the same here, unless there is support in the books for a male (or female or neuter) pronoun.  I encourage everyone to remember that it's not what modern PC convention says is right, but what Robert Jordan put in the universe that is right.

[[User:Pedantic|Pedantic]] 00:11, April 21, 2012 (UTC)

:In all of his interviews, Robert Jordan referred to the Creator as a He. ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 12:35, April 21, 2012 (UTC)

==Eye of the World==
I just listened through the EotW again and for the first time (of at least 5) I thought that there is a really good chance that the voice Rand hears at Tarwin's Gap was NOT the creator, but rather the Dark One.  Rand yells out a challenge to <span style="font-size:11.6666669845581px;line-height:17.5px;">Ba'alzamon. </span>The voice referencing the "Chosen One" speaks afterwards, and then Rand travels to find Ishmael, the Nae'blis or chosen of the Chosen.  Perhaps the voice is the first appearance of Shai'tan in the book?  And therefore Rand's calling out to Ba'alzamon drew his attention?
